output.custom_role_id exposes manually constructed role IDs but has no dependency on google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles in the supplied graph. iam.tf explicitly tells callers to use this output to ensure custom roles exist, yet consumers currently receive no creation-order guarantee. Add depends_on = [google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles] to the output, preserving the deliberately plan-known ID strings used as map keys.
